Text: Carries fluid in a straight line. Rotate to aim the run.
Beavers argued for days about whether water prefers to travel in straight lines. The pipe settled it.
Turns a pipe run 90°. Flip for the other way.
A vertical plus: two opposite sides plus up and down. Rotate to choose the horizontal axis. You can stack a Riser on it.
Stand it up if you must.
A one-way straight pipe. Pause to close it. Rotate to reverse flow. Point a directed end at a building to pour into it or draw from it.
The water may pass. The water may not come back.
A powered one-way straight pipe. Needs 40 hp. Pushes 0.2 m³ into the next tile, up to 2 m of headlift. Rotate to reverse.
The pipe got tired of waiting for gravity.
A stackable powered riser that always lifts. Needs 40 hp. Pushes 0.2 m³ into the tile above, up to 2 m of headlift.
Gravity included. This time you can argue with it.
This empties every pipe in this network and clears contamination. Continue?
